_about: SPEC-SHAPED, NOT A CAPTURED RESPONSE. GET api.runpod.io/v2/catalog/gpus needs a Bearer key (scope catalog:read; unauthenticated it answers 401, see runpod_rest_401_2026-11-13.json) and none was used. Each body follows the GpuType schema of https://api.runpod.io/v2/openapi.json (2.0.0, fetched 2026-11-13) and carries the values of the real GraphQL body runpod_graphql_pods_2026-11-13.json captured the same minute: price = securePrice / communityPrice, availability = that cell's stockStatus upper-cased (NONE when null), minVcpuCount / minRam = minVcpu / minMemory, pool = the gpuPools pool listing the id. maxCount (required) is the largest priced size seen, a stand-in; dataCenters and price.serverless are omitted (not known without the key). Replace with a real capture once a key is used.
